description: Daytime patrol of a commercial office campus. Tests altitude anomaly, daytime vehicle tracking, variant phrasing, ambiguous descriptions, a lunchtime crowd, an unauthorized restricted-zone entry, and an end-of-day tailgating attempt.

frames.description: Main entrance clear. Security guard at the booth. Barrier is down.
Black Maruti Suzuki Swift entering campus through the main entrance.
Swift parked in visitor parking. Driver, a woman in formal attire, walks toward the building.
frames.expected: log — vehicle parked, person detected (daytime, no alert)

frames.description: White Honda Civic entering campus. Altitude unusually high due to wind drift.
A pickup truck entering campus, make unclear from this angle.
frames.expected: log — variant phrasing pickup maps to truck subtype

frames.description: An individual in casual clothing walking past the restricted zone barrier and entering the zone.
frames.expected: log — person at restricted zone (daytime, no loitering alert but stateful tracking)

frames.description: Something moving near the server room entrance. Hard to determine if it is a person or equipment being moved.
frames.expected: log — ambiguous frame, analyzer robustness test

frames.description: Several employees gathered in the courtyard during lunch break. No suspicious activity.
frames.expected: log — multiple persons, daytime, no alert

frames.description: Grey SUV parked in visitor parking. Make and registration unclear from altitude.
F-150 truck exiting campus through the main entrance.
A person climbing up the external fire escape ladder toward the rooftop access door.
frames.expected: ALERT: critical perimeter breach — climbing activity

frames.description: Black Maruti Swift still parked in visitor parking area. No activity around it.
frames.expected: log — existing entity vehicle#1 still on premises

frames.description: Several cars leaving campus in quick succession as day shift ends.
frames.expected: log — end of day activity, multiple vehicles

frames.description: Black Maruti Suzuki Swift exiting through the main entrance.
Black Maruti Swift re-entering campus immediately after exiting — possible tailgating attempt.
White delivery van parked at the rear gate. Rear doors open, two people unloading boxes.
frames.expected: log — after-hours borderline (19:00 within 06-22 window, no alert)

frames.description: Pigeons roosting on the courtyard benches. No human activity visible.
White van still parked at rear gate with doors open. No personnel visible now.
Drone flying very low over the main entrance during routine perimeter check.
Quiet rooftop. Access door appears closed. No personnel detected.
